transcript.text:
Here's a walkthrough of the four API calls you need.

---

## Step 1: Get an OAuth2 Bearer Token

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={clientId}
&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Save the `access_token` from the response — every subsequent call uses it as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

---

## Step 2: Create the Source

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  "description": "Corporate AD",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "{ownerIdentityId}",
    "name": "Admin User"
  },
  "cluster": {
    "type": "CLUSTER",
    "id": "{vaClusterId}",
    "name": "Corp VA Cluster"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorClass": "sailpoint.connector.ADLDAPConnector",
  "connectionType": "direct",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "IQServiceHost": "iqservice.corp.local",
    "IQServicePort": "5050",
    "forestSettings": [
      {
        "forest": "corp.local",
        "user": "svc-iq@corp.local",
        "password": "s3cr3t"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

The response body includes the new source's `id` — you need it for the next call.

**Key fields:**
- `connector` — short connector type identifier (e.g. `active-directory`, `delimited-file`, `jdbc`)
- `connectorClass` — fully-qualified Java class for the connector
- `cluster` — required for on-prem connectors; omit for cloud-native
- `connectorAttributes` — connector-specific config; schema varies by connector type

---

## Step 3: Kick Off Account Aggregation

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "disableOptimization": false
}
```

Set `disableOptimization: true` to force a full aggregation (skip delta tracking). The response body contains a `task` object with an `id`.

---

## Step 4: Poll for Completion (optional but recommended)

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/task-status/{taskId}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Check `task.completionStatus` — values are `SUCCESS`, `ERROR`, or `PENDING`/`IN_PROGRESS` while running. Also look at `task.attributes.optimizedAggregation` and `task.attributes.accountsWithDeletedAssignments` in the result for a summary of what was processed.

---

**Scope requirements** — the client credentials app needs at minimum:
- `idn:sources:manage` (create source + trigger aggregation)
- `idn:task-management:read` (poll task status)

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
    api_version: beta
  - method: GET
    path: /beta/task-status/{taskId}
    api_version: beta
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client_credentials grant)
required_scopes: [idn:sources:manage, idn:task-management:read]
key_parameters: [grant_type, client_id, client_secret, name, owner, cluster, connector, connectorClass, connectorAttributes, disableOptimization, sourceId, taskId]
```
